subject: Compliance roadmap: ISO 27001 & FedRAMP readiness — intake and audit window coordination
messages:
From: Claire Liu <claire.liu@acmebank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmebank.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood compliance roadmap & pre-audit intake

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Acme Bank is preparing for a vendor assurance cycle that covers both ISO 27001 alignment and a FedRAMP-adjacent assessment for cloud-hosted inference. Our security team has asked for a high-level compliance roadmap and an initial intake so we can schedule the auditor and lock sample windows.

High level asks to start:
- Proposed target audit window (we're targeting Sep–Oct but need your confirmation)
- Scope sketch: which Redwood products and regions will be in-scope (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private)
- Evidence retention baseline and key control owners (encryption/KMS, access logs, IAAS config snapshots)
- Any known third-party attestations we can share now (SOC 2, supplier attestations)

Can you send a short intake and a proposed timeline by EOD Monday? Auditor contact: auditor@thirdparty-audit.com — they will want a bucketed list of artifacts and proposed sample dates.

Thanks,
Claire Liu
Head of Third-Party Risk
Acme Bank

P.S. procurement asked to see estimated effort so they can coordinate PO timing.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Liu <claire.liu@acmebank.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance roadmap & pre-audit intake

Claire,

Appreciate the clarity — we can turn around a concise intake and timeline. Sending a sketch (attached: initial-scope-sketch.xlsx) and a short proposed timeline below. Can we schedule a 30-min alignment early next week with your auditor to agree sample windows?

Proposed target audit window: 2028-09-15 to 2028-10-15
Proposed scope: Hosted API + Dedicated capacity in us-west-2; Private (VPC) excluded unless customer-requested for this engagement
Initial evidence categories we plan to provide: control narratives, configuration snapshots, log retention records, KMS key custody statements, SOC 2 report (latest), automated test logs for RBAC changes

Open clarifying questions for your team:
- Do you need customer isolation evidence for Dedicated pools vs Hosted?
- Are CMKs (customer-managed keys) required in-scope for FedRAMP evaluation?
- Auditor preferred sample size for user access reviews and configuration snapshots?

I'll add action items after our internal sync. Attaching a first-pass scope sketch.

Best,
Aditya
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: initial-scope-sketch.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance roadmap & pre-audit intake

On Fri, 30 Jun 2028 at 10:20, Aditya Rao wrote:
> Proposed target audit window: 2028-09-15 to 2028-10-15
> Proposed scope: Hosted API + Dedicated capacity in us-west-2; Private (VPC) excluded unless customer-requested for this engagement

Quick internal notes / suggestions before we send to Claire:
- Control owners: I will own encryption/KMS narratives and provide KMS policy exports and HSM integration notes.
- Kimberly, can you confirm log retention snapshots (elk snapshots and S3 retention policies) and a sample extraction approach? We should propose a 30-day window for snapshot extraction plus a 12-month retention artifact.
- Marissa, we should surface the last SOC 2 report and a short list of compensating controls for anything we cannot provide in the timebox.

Risk items to flag to Acme:
- If they require CMK attestation across Dedicated pools, that adds work (KMS proof of CMK wrapping + keys-of-record documentation).
- FedRAMP-style control families will expect IAM traceability; propose a pre-sample dry run with the auditor to validate extraction scripts.

Action: I'll draft an evidence-intake-matrix.csv that maps control -> owner -> artifact -> earliest-available-date. Will circulate by Monday morning.

Mina
Senior Security PM

From: Claire Liu <claire.liu@acmebank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: ThirdParty Audit <auditor@thirdparty-audit.com>, procurement@acmebank.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance roadmap & pre-audit intake

Thanks — that timeline looks workable. Auditor (cc) suggested a pre-audit dry run the week of 2028-08-05 to validate extraction and sample scripts; does that work for you?

For clarity:
- We will need the SOC 2 report and the KMS policy exports ahead of the dry run (target 2028-07-18)
- Sample window for logs: 2028-08-01 to 2028-08-31 (auditor requested a contiguous 30-day period rather than piecemeal samples)
- Procurement asked for a one-page estimate of effort and deliverables to move PO forward; please include level-of-effort ranges for CMK work vs standard evidence delivery.

Auditor contact: Erin Cole <auditor@thirdparty-audit.com> — Erin, Claire and I will join the dry run; please propose 2 slots for 2028-08-05 or 2028-08-06.

Claire

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Liu <claire.liu@acmebank.com>, ThirdParty Audit <auditor@thirdparty-audit.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance roadmap & pre-audit intake

Summary and next steps (action owners):
1) Evidence drop by 2028-07-18: SOC 2 report (Marissa), KMS policy exports + HSM design note (Mina).
2) Draft evidence-intake-matrix.csv (Mina) and control mapping doc (Marissa) due 2028-07-09 for internal review.
3) Dry run with auditor: propose 2028-08-05 10:00-11:00 PT or 2028-08-06 14:00-15:00 PT — Erin, please confirm preferred slot.
4) Sample window (auditor requested): 2028-08-01 -> 2028-08-31. Kimberly to validate extraction scripts and confirm snapshot access.
5) Procurement one-pager estimate (Aditya & Marissa): to procurement@acmebank.com by 2028-07-05.

Attachments uploaded to shared Drive: evidence-intake-matrix.csv, control-mapping-draft.docx, fedramp-readiness-summary.pdf. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Compliance-Intake

I'll follow up with calendar invites and a short internal playbook for the dry run (what artifacts to stage, who needs to be on the call).

Thanks all — moving to execution.

Aditya
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-intake-matrix.csv; control-mapping-draft.docx; fedramp-readiness-summary.pdf
